title: Carnes Farms sets Nov. 21 opening for Pontotoc Christmas tree season
excerpt: Carnes Farms will open from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 21, at 164 Hurt-Wood Road in Pontotoc.

sources.title: November 21, 2024 state agriculture department interview announcement
sources.publisher: Mississippi Department of Agriculture and Commerce

facts.statement: Carnes Farms will open its Christmas tree season Saturday, Nov. 21, at 164 Hurt-Wood Road in Pontotoc. Opening-day hours are 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., according to the announcement shared by Pontotoc County Chamber Main Street.
facts.evidence: The Chamber post identifies the opening and address. Its original flyer, inspected visually, gives 10:00am–5:00pm on Saturday, November 21.
facts.date_context: Opening on Saturday, November 21, 2026. Historical dates are identified separately.
facts.identities: Carnes Farms; Adam and Ali Carnes; Pontotoc County Chamber Main Street.

facts.statement: Adam and Ali Carnes began growing Christmas trees in 2019. The first-generation farmers described how they established the farm in a 2024 interview for Freshly Picked, a Mississippi Department of Agriculture and Commerce podcast.
facts.evidence: The November 21, 2024 department release identifies the owners, the 2019 planting start, the podcast and their account of getting started.
facts.date_context: Opening on Saturday, November 21, 2026. Historical dates are identified separately.
facts.identities: Carnes Farms; Adam and Ali Carnes; Pontotoc County Chamber Main Street.

facts.statement: Visitors can reach Carnes Farms at 662-419-1286, the number listed in the state’s agritourism directory. The hours in the Chamber announcement apply to opening day.
facts.evidence: The Mississippi Market Bulletin agritourism directory lists the farm/business phone in Pontotoc County. The Chamber flyer labels the hours as opening day.

paragraphs.text: Carnes Farms will open its Christmas tree season Saturday, Nov. 21, at 164 Hurt-Wood Road in Pontotoc. Opening-day hours are 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., according to the announcement shared by Pontotoc County Chamber Main Street.

Adam and Ali Carnes began growing Christmas trees in 2019. The first-generation farmers described how they established the farm in a 2024 interview for Freshly Picked, a Mississippi Department of Agriculture and Commerce podcast.
Visitors can reach Carnes Farms at 662-419-1286, the number listed in the state’s agritourism directory. The hours in the Chamber announcement apply to opening day.
